transcript.text: Good morning everyone. Let's get this recovery huddle started. As we all know, robotic palletizer P-4 went down during the morning shift, and we have an urgent outbound order due at the end of the week. We have the manual palletizing station in the finished-goods warehouse available as a temporary alternative. Before I settle on a recovery plan, I need each functional owner to present their current finding as a named entry in the huddle log. That's a requirement of our agenda -- a spoken discussion alone won't complete it. So let's hear from maintenance first, then shipment staging, then safety on energy-isolation controls. Who's ready to go first?
